subject.title: fix(mac-gateway): write launchd stderr to a log file and surface it in diagnostics (#90711)

question: Should lifecycle-complete fixed retention be finished in this stderr PR, or should the broader retention PR own the permanent launchd log policy?
rationale: The current cap is mechanically incomplete, while the overlapping PR proposes materially different limits, archive behavior, failure semantics, and environment-variable surface; code review cannot safely choose that permanent operator contract.

options.title: Complete fixed retention here
options.body: Cover every safe external and detached restart mode without adding configuration, then retire or narrow the competing retention implementation.

options.title: Delegate retention policy
options.body: Remove the partial cap from this branch and sequence stderr restoration with a rebased broader retention PR using current supervisor paths.

options.title: Accept the growth window
options.body: Merge the current behavior while explicitly accepting that routine restarts and unattended relaunches can grow the stderr file until a later covered install or plist-changing restart.

recommendation.title: Complete fixed retention here
recommendation.body: Cover every safe external and detached restart mode without adding configuration, then retire or narrow the competing retention implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The surviving history shows the broadest recent ownership across launchd lifecycle, diagnostics, and log-path code, spanning the full decision surface.
